items.claim: the W1/W2 reclassification holds: the blue net name overlaps the pin-name glyphs, not the wire

evidence.image: r8t1-main-tile-r4c0.png (2.323 px/unit) viewed in full and cropped at the W1/W2 boxes. Left-side blue labels sit on the green wires, left of the black pin names PA0-PA12; the pin names are fully readable. Right-side blue labels sit after the black pin numbers (18,19,20,39,...) and to the right of PB0-PB7; the pin names are fully readable. No glyph-over-glyph overlap is visible.
evidence.w1_crop: r12t2-w1-tile.png: blue MCU-34 on the green wire; black PA10 to its right, readable; the label's right edge is adjacent to PA10, not over it.
evidence.w2_crop: r12t2-w2-tile.png: blue MCU-26 after black pin number 21; the nearest text is the pin number, not a pin name; there is no pin name under the label. The JSON's overlappedText='same-row pin name' is not supported.
evidence.coords: attr111 (MCU-34) at (210,795) is a wire label on the left; attr102 (MCU-26) at (390,795) is at the far wire end. The nearest black text to 390 is the pin number around x=350-370 (tile mapping at 2.323 px/unit), not a pin name.
evidence.d_argument: d=5.0 is the anchor-to-wire distance. A 14pt glyph is about 14 units tall (half-height about 7 > 5), so the wire lies inside the text's vertical extent; this supports 'label on the wire', not 'only grazing the edge'.
evidence.high_zoom: r12t1-mcu.png / r12t1-mcuR.png at 8.25 px/unit show the same: PA10/PA11 readable, the blue MCU-34/33 at the pin end over the red pin stub, and the left labels on the green wires.
evidence.conclusion: the labels are over the wire / pin stub; the pin names are adjacent and readable. The text-text classification and the PA10/pin-name pairings are not supported by the cited tile. Recommend restoring 'net name over wire/pin stub' (or marking it 待定) and re-opening the wire-under-label candidate instead of calling it 判不了.

items.claim: the A-box root cause is text31 overflow, not content duplication; the 'same string twice' is the overview mosaic seam

evidence.one_text: scan of t31-dataset.json texts (39): exactly one contains dsh-t19-real-ic-1792425596633 - PrimitiveId text31, X=404, Y=116, FontSize=16, 28 chars.
evidence.zero_attrs: scan of all 662 attrs for the string or for '项目': 0 hits.
evidence.overflow: 28 chars x 7.54 units/char = 211.1 units > 186-unit cell (404-590) => about 25 units overflow; t1's measured 208.4 / 23.3 is consistent. r12t2-abox-tail.png (frame 540-620) shows the project-name tail reaching the 图幅 column boundary; the exact 613.3 endpoint was not re-measured to 0.1 unit.
evidence.mosaic: r9t1-main-view-guide.mjs L379-386 draws each tile at pad + col*tileW with no crop of the shared band. Tile rects: r0c0 x -2..509.8, r0c1 x 400.2..912.0 => 400.2..509.8 (109.6 units) is drawn twice in the composite.
evidence.conclusion: the primitive data cannot produce the duplicate (only one text, no attribute, empty titleBlockData); the composite tiling does. t1's 'verified, not speculated' is correct. This is a negative result for the old 'two texts/attribute duplicate' hypotheses and a positive result for the mosaic-seam explanation.

findings.w1w2: the mechanical change is present, but the pixels contradict it: the labels are on the wires/pin stubs and the pin names/numbers are adjacent and readable. At W2 the nearest text is the pin number, not a pin name; the JSON's 'same-row pin name' is wrong. The reclassification should be re-adjudicated; the wire-under-label candidate is real, not 判不了.
findings.aBox: verified: one text31, zero attrs, empty titleBlockData, 28x7.54 > 186 overflow, and the mosaic seam is in the generator code and tile rects. The duplicate is an evidence-chain artifact, not a schematic duplicate.
findings.residual: guide L114 still says 导线穿符号 记为无候选, while L48/L52/L115 say 判不了. One sentence is stale (minor wording inconsistency).
findings.selfCorrection: my earlier r12t1 titleV frame (400-480) did not cover the A-box tail (560-613); the earlier 'A-box not reproduced' was out of frame and is withdrawn. r12t2-abox-tail.png (540-620) covers the tail and is consistent with the overflow.

overall: partial: t2 is sound (L113/L114, matrix, counts, nits, no overreach all pass). t1's A-box root cause is verified, but the W1/W2 text-text reclassification is not supported by the cited tile - the labels sit on the wires/pin stubs and the pin names are adjacent/readable. The 'wire-through-text = 2 candidates' removal should be revisited.

limits: The r4c0 tile is 2.323 px/unit; the exact overlap at the sub-unit level is at the edge of its resolution. The conclusion rests on the full tile plus the two crops and the 8.25 px/unit r12t1 images, not on a sub-pixel measurement.

The page coordinates of individual pin names are not in the dataset (sch_PrimitivePin returns 0; pin names are symbol-internal), so the pin-name positions are read from pixels at 2.323 px/unit and are approximate.
The exact text31 ink endpoint 613.3 was not re-measured; the overflow is confirmed by arithmetic (28 x 7.54 > 186) and the tail image, not to 0.1 unit.
The host's visual call is the group's authority; this is an independent read that disagrees on W1/W2 and recommends re-adjudication, not a unilateral revert.
